sloka: पूर्वजा भगिनी च अपि मम राघव सुव्रता ।नाम्ना सत्यवती नाम ऋचीके प्रतिपादिता ॥१-३४-७॥
transliteration: pūrvajā bhaginī ca api mama rāghava suvratā ।nāmnā satyavatī nāma ṛcīke pratipāditā ॥1-34-7॥

translations.english: O Raghava adherent of best religious practices, is my elder sister well known by name Satyavati. She was bestowed in marriage to Richika.
